# SparseRead

> Token-efficient reading for AI agents.

SparseRead is a training-free reading layer that admits only the evidence needed for the next decision, instead of dumping whole files, PDFs, or repositories into context.

- Website: https://sparseread.pages.dev/
- Code: https://github.com/Liuzedooong/SparseReading
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22237
- PDF: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.22237

## What it is

A thin adapter around one token-efficient reading runtime, not a new agent. A Read Gate decides whether to read sparse; Reader Backends admit a bounded evidence slice. It is not post-hoc summarization, KV-cache compression, or an always-on replacement for native tools.

## Installation

Download the updated v0.1.4 source installer ZIP and SHA256SUMS-20261114 from
https://github.com/Liuzedooong/SparseReading/releases/tag/v0.1.4 and follow the
installation guide. For OpenCode V2, --global installs for the current user.
Fresh global installs default to advisory. The terminal suggests auto once on
a successful evidence read at least 48 hours after the first.
PyPI project registration is pending.

## Adapter validation

The source tree contains Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw, NanoBot, Codex and Pi
adapters. Scoped macOS arm64 host validation includes OpenCode 2.3.0 and V1
1.17.14/1.19.5, Claude Code 2.1.325 and Codex CLI 0.169.0. Validation is specific to host version and platform. NanoBot 0.4.1
passed scoped macOS AgentLoop tests: each persistent turn requires selecting
stock read_file before direct SparseRead source access, and shell stays native.
The 05768c8 source archive passed scoped macOS Pi 0.87.1 and OpenClaw
2026.7.1-2 regression; these are fixed-version checks, not
latest-version upgrade claims. Historical paper results do not establish
newer-host performance. See the source repository's validation matrix for details.

## Results (paper, vs Naive full reading)

- Token volume down by up to 92.9%.
- Wall time down by up to 89.0%.
- Quality held or improved on 26 of 30 NanoBot cells.
- Keep “up to” on the maxima. Token volume is not automatically dollar cost.

## 中文

SparseRead 是面向 AI Agent 的省 token 阅读层：先拦截整文件 / PDF / 仓库的全文灌入，再按下一步决策需要的证据读取。论文 arXiv:2608.22237。
